leakage_model.declassification: declassify x e is the only release: it emits release v and assigns v to a public variable x. D2-TH04 allows two runs to differ first at a release and nowhere earlier.
leakage_model.nonclaims: The model is suite-only. It does not model timing, caches, speculation or the hardware, and it neither ratifies nor drafts D-012.
leakage_model.observations: Each step emits the addresses it reads and writes, the outcome of every branch, every out-of-bounds address, and every released value, in evaluation order.
leakage_model.public_equivalence: low_eq: two states agree on every declared public variable and every declared public array.
